name: singlet_neighbors_batch_aware_knn_graph
title: Batch-aware kNN graph construction
description: Builds a symmetric weighted cell neighbour graph whose neighbours come from several batches: per-batch neighbours (bbknn, the default), mutual-neighbour pairs (mnn), Seurat CCA anchors, or kNN on a Harmony, Scanorama or scVI corrected space. Writes connectivities, distances and the corrected space under a key. Use after dimensionality reduction when batches must mix in the graph used for clustering or embedding. Do not use for a single batch, to score integration (use integration.integration_quality_scoring) or to choose k (use neighbors.neighbor_count_selection).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Graph method. bbknn (default) draws neighbours from each batch; uncorrected_knn is the baseline with no batch information.

batch_key.description: obs column with the batch covariate; at least two levels and no missing values.

key.description: Stem of the output members obsp/<key>_connectivities, obsp/<key>_distances, obsm/<key>_embedding and uns/<key>_params.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours per cell for kNN-type methods, self excluded. Ignored by bbknn, which uses options.bbknn.neighbors_within_batch.

matching.description: Matching space and features shared by all methods.

use_rep.description: obsm embedding to match on (cells by dimensions); no missing values.

n_pcs.description: Leading dimensions of use_rep used by bbknn, harmony_knn and uncorrected_knn.

n_hvg.description: Highly variable genes used by mnn, seurat_anchors and scanorama_knn.

options.description: Method options, one nested object per method family. Only the chosen method's object is read.

neighbors_within_batch.description: Neighbours taken from each batch; 25 is the scIB choice for atlases of at least 1e5 cells.

trim.description: Edges kept per cell by weight; null uses 10 times the total neighbours; 0 disables trimming.

annoy_n_trees.description: Trees in the annoy forest used for per-batch search.

approx.description: true uses annoy approximate search; false uses exact brute-force search.

mnn.description: Options for method mnn (mutual nearest neighbours, expression space).

k.description: Neighbours used to find mutual nearest-neighbour pairs between batches.

sigma.description: Gaussian bandwidth smoothing correction vectors, as a fraction of the cosine-normalised radius.

cos_norm.description: Cosine-normalise expression before pair search and correction.

seurat.description: Options for method seurat_anchors (CCA reduction only).

dims.description: CCA dimensions 1 to dims used to find anchors.

k_filter.description: Neighbours for anchor filtering; null disables filtering.

theta.description: Diversity penalty favouring clusters that contain several batches; 0 disables it.

sigma.description: Entropy penalty on soft cluster assignments.

nclust.description: Number of soft clusters; null uses min(round(N/30), 100).

alpha.description: Ridge scale used to estimate lambda when lambda is unset.

knn.description: Neighbours used for approximate mutual matching between batches.

sigma.description: Kernel bandwidth of the alignment weights.

alpha.description: Alignment penalty of the Scanorama matching.

dimred.description: SVD dimensions used by the matching step.

approx.description: Use approximate neighbour search in the matching step.

batch_size.description: Cells per block in the alignment step.

scvi.description: Options for method scvi_knn (trains a model on counts).

n_latent.description: Latent dimension of the posterior mean used for the graph.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers in encoder and decoder.

dropout_rate.description: Dropout rate in encoder and decoder.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for stochastic methods (harmony_knn, scanorama_knn, scvi_knn) and subsampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsp/batch_knn_connectivities. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_cells, n_batches, mean_degree, cross_batch_weight_share, device, seed.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
